properties.name: 17-AP-4249
properties.notes: Conversion of the first and second floors into 1 x one-bed flat at first floor and 1 x one-bed flat at second and third floor levels. The proposed scheme includes a new shop front, loft conversion / dormer extension with Juliet balcony and 3 x Velux windows in the front roofslope and 2 x Velux windows in the rear roofslope, with rear terraces at 1st and 2nd floor levels.
